args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 the service requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail because `tests/test_money.py` asserts banker's rounding behavior (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`
- Pass `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to `amount.quantize()`

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
